mapper.select: SELECT activity.id, "session".id as sessionid, activity."name", activity.category, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", '(' || CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD')) WHEN 1 THEN '一' WHEN 2 THEN '二' WHEN 3 THEN '三' WHEN 4 THEN '四' WHEN 5 THEN '五' WHEN 6 THEN '六' WHEN 7 THEN '日' end || ')' AS dow, "session"."time" AS "time", activity.venue, activity.status, activity.price, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session".salesdate, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' (' || CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM TO_DATE("session".salesdate, 'YYYY/MM/DD')) WHEN 1 THEN '一' WHEN 2 THEN '二' WHEN 3 THEN '三' WHEN 4 THEN '四' WHEN 5 THEN '五' WHEN 6 THEN '六' WHEN 7 THEN '日' end || ') ' || "session".salestime AS sales_start, activity.description FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity INNER JOIN "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" ON activity."name" = "session".activity ORDER BY activity.id
